prompt: How many units were sold, in total, of the products that take part in at least one promotion? A product takes part when at least one promotion lists it, and each order line's quantity counts once. Return one column, units. Which query returns it?

options.text:
SELECT SUM(ol.quantity) AS units
FROM order_lines ol
JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.product_id = ol.product_id

SELECT SUM(DISTINCT ol.quantity) AS units
FROM order_lines ol
JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.product_id = ol.product_id

WITH promo_products AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT product_id
  FROM promotion_products
)
SELECT SUM(ol.quantity) AS units
FROM order_lines ol
JOIN promo_products pp ON pp.product_id = ol.product_id

WITH promo_products AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT product_id
  FROM promotion_products
)
SELECT SUM(ol.quantity) AS units
FROM order_lines ol
LEFT JOIN promo_products pp ON pp.product_id = ol.product_id
